origin.description: Majority label of the k nearest training rows.
origin.usage: knn(train, test, cl, k=1, l=0, prob=FALSE, use.all=TRUE)

arguments.name: cl
arguments.text: Class label of each training row.

origin.details: The checked rows have one nearest class. A tied vote keeps the smallest class code.
origin.value: One label code per test row.
origin.example: cat(as.integer(knn(matrix(c(0,0, 1,0, 0,3, 10,0), ncol=2, byrow=TRUE), matrix(c(0.1,0.1, 9,0.1), ncol=2, byrow=TRUE), factor(c("a","b","a","b")), k=3)), "\n")

arguments.name: cl
